pkbillmsBookkeepingTransaction.note: This form is designed for selecting accounting entries, for mutual settlements with service providers. These entries are not automatically generated in the ABS, so you need to perform a number of functions to display them in the ABS. First of all make sure that the day in the ABS is open and on the balance of your account there is enough money to make the postings. Also, make sure that there are no other reasons for rejecting the entries. When all factors are eliminated, you need to approve the posting. This is also where you need to make sure that the amount of the posting is correct. After the postings are approved, you need to run them. If there are no errors, and an ID is received confirming that the posting was successful, you can proceed to process the next posting. If any error occurs, carefully check all parameters once again and try to repeat the operation. If there is an error here as well, contact the Administrator to resolve the problem.
